ud6.7:4.4: For “they never return” (na jātu’m’eti) there is a variant reading “go to rebirth” (jātim eti) in Śarīrārthagāthā 32, which here is very close to the Pali. The commentary also acknowledges this variant: ‘Na jāti metī’tipi paṭhanti, so evattho. Despite this confusion, jātu (“ever”) and jāti (“rebirth”) are different words.
